address.description: Coolify endpoint. If not set, checks env for `COOLIFY_ADDRESS`. Default: `https://app.coolify.io`.

token.description: Coolify token. If not set, checks env for `COOLIFY_TOKEN`.

connect_to_docker_network.description: Connect the application to Coolify's predefined Docker network.

destination_uuid.description: Destination UUID. Required when the server has multiple destinations.

docker_registry_image_name.description: Fully qualified image name. For GCP Artifact Registry use the `LOCATION-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT/REPO/IMAGE` form.

docker_registry_image_tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to `latest` on the Coolify side when omitted.

domains.description: Application URLs in a comma-separated list.

environment_variables.description: Environment variables to upsert in bulk on the application. Variables not listed here are left untouched, so individual entries can be managed via `coolify_application_env`. Values are marked sensitive and hidden from plan output.

fqdn.description: Application fully qualified domain name(s) as a comma-separated string.

health_check_return_code.description: Expected health check HTTP status code.

health_check_start_period.description: Health check start period in seconds.

ports_exposes.description: Container ports to expose, comma-separated (e.g. `"8080"` or `"80,443"`).

redeploy_on_update.description: When `true`, trigger a redeploy after a successful update if any runtime-affecting field changed. Coolify's update endpoint only persists configuration; without this flag a changed image tag, env or port will not take effect until the next manual deploy. Fields that trigger a redeploy: `docker_registry_image_name`, `docker_registry_image_tag`, `environment_variables`, `ports_exposes`, `ports_mappings`, `domains`, `is_force_https_enabled`, `connect_to_docker_network`, all `health_check_*`, all `limits_*`, `custom_labels`, `custom_docker_run_options`. Changes to `name` or `description` alone do not trigger a redeploy.

block.description: Deploy a Coolify application based on a prebuilt Docker image hosted on any registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, GCP Artifact Registry, AWS ECR, etc.). The `environment_variables` map performs a bulk upsert against the application after creation, mirroring the ergonomics of `google_cloud_run_v2_service.template[0].containers[0].env`.

application_uuid.description: UUID of the application this variable belongs to.

is_literal.description: Whether the value is treated as a literal (no escaping).

is_multiline.description: Whether the value spans multiple lines.

is_preview.description: Whether the variable is used in preview deployments.

is_shown_once.description: Whether the value is shown only once in the Coolify UI.

block.description: Manage a single environment variable on a Coolify application. Use this resource when you need to set per-variable flags such as `is_preview`, `is_literal`, `is_multiline` or `is_shown_once`. For the simple `KEY = value` case, prefer the `environment_variables` map on `coolify_application_dockerimage`.

private_key_uuid.description: The UUID of the private key associated with the server.

environment_variables.description: All non-sensitive environment variables currently set on the application.
